messages:
maya: quick thread  thinking about adding a compact 'anchor' action in the timepicker so PMs/engineers can capture a specific window (deploy, experiment) and jump straight to it on the heatmap/p95. main goals: reliable comparisons, easy sharing.

leo: important to define persistence: session by default, with an explicit 'save comparison' action that produces a permalink. how do users create anchors? double-click the range? a small + inside the picker?

maya: propose a small + button in the picker and keyboard shortcut (Enter when focused on range). default session-scoped.

sam: sampling caveat: we use reservoir sampling per time-bucket which can make p95 fluctuate when bucket boundaries move. options: align buckets to anchors (costly), surface sampling metadata, or offer a full-scan toggle (expensive). I suggest: show a "Sampled" badge, expose sampling_rate and sampling_strategy via API, and add an explicit "Full scan" button behind a cost warning.

tia: a11y checklist: anchor creation must be keyboard-accessible and announced via aria-live ("Anchor created: <label>"). marker accessible name and tooltip. marker color needs >=4.5:1 contrast; ensure focus order: timepicker -> anchor list -> chart.

aria: microcopy: button label "Create anchor"; tooltip "Capture this window for quick comparison". badge copy: "Sampled" with tooltip: "This view uses sampled data (%s). Click to run a full scan." Visual: slim vertical marker; suggested color #083E86 but tia to validate contrast and provide token.

leo: UX perf: when switching anchors stream deltas (anchor_mode=stream) so the UI stays snappy. full-mode re-queries only when user requests exact numbers. show a subtle loading shimmer for buckets being fetched.

sam: we'll add sampling_rate and sampling_strategy to metrics and accept anchor_mode=stream|full on the query API. streaming should be default for anchors. we'll also add a small telemetry opt-in note since this adds fields.

ux-bot: A11Y quick checklist:
 Anchor creation reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space).
 Announce anchor creation with aria-live.
 Marker color passes 4.5:1 contrast.
 Sampled badge has accessible name and tooltip.
 Logical focus order preserved.

maya: next steps: aria + color pass (tia/aria) and updated mock with keyboard flow by EOD tomorrow. eng (sam/leo) to confirm API flags and telemetry scope by EOD. I'll book 20m review Fri 11am. thanks :heart:
